segments.name: Agriculture
segments.description: Develops seed traits and ag-chemical products for agricultural activities, including through subsidiary AgPlenus.
segments.evidence: our agriculture segment includes our division and subsidiary engaged in agricultural activities, including seed traits activity and ag-chemicals activity (through our subsidiary AgPlenus).

segments.name: Human Health
segments.description: Discovers and develops microbiome-based therapeutics and designs small molecules for drug development using AI.
segments.evidence: our human health segment focuses mainly on discovery and development of human microbiome-based therapeutics (through our subsidiary Biomica) and Canonic (which ceased its operations in 2024).

segments.name: Industrial Applications
segments.description: Develops and commercializes improved castor bean seeds for industrial uses, through subsidiary Casterra.
segments.evidence: our industrial applications segment focuses on the development and commercialization of improved castor bean seeds for industrial uses (through our subsidiary Casterra).

revenueModel.text: Collaborators pay the company research funding, milestone payments and royalties under collaboration and licensing agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: Furthermore, the various payments we receive from our collaborators are currently our primary source of revenues.

changes.text: In 2024, Canonic, part of the Human Health segment, ceased its operations.
